description: Automated dependency updates for the Bitbucket CLI. Renovate is used instead of Dependabot because it understands Bun's `bun.lock` and updates the manifest + lockfile together. It auto-discovers both package manifests (root and docs/), keeps the SHA-pinned GitHub Actions current, and bumps the pinned Bun runtime used across the CI workflows.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Refresh transitive dependencies in bun.lock (root + docs/) once a month.
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes bypass the weekly schedule so they land as soon as they are available.

customManagers.description: Track the pinned `BUN_VERSION` used by every GitHub Actions workflow against Bun's GitHub releases.

packageRules.description: Batch all non-major npm updates (root + docs/) into a single low-risk PR; existing CI gates them.
Major npm updates each get their own labelled PR so breaking changes are reviewed deliberately.
Keep the SHA-pinned GitHub Actions current in their own grouped PR.
Surface the Bun runtime bump on its own PR — it changes the CI/test matrix and warrants a deliberate look.
